sourceRevisionScope: Production store and legacy settings checks at this revision; new process/model verification artifacts are independently pinned by hash.
scope: Original ELM-DEL-015 settings-storage: actual supported schema1-to2 migration preserves exact original before atomic active publication; invalid refusal and injected/abrupt process-interruption old-or-new recovery. Other adopted fixed-schema stores/recovery imports checked by source correspondence. No hardware power-loss, arbitrary concurrency, native/UI/AT or release acceptance.

scenarios.name: delivery-015
scenarios.oracle: valid new settings and recoverable original settings exist

scenarios.name: invalid-settings
scenarios.oracle: the active settings remain unchanged and validation refuses the write

scenarios.name: interrupted-settings
scenarios.oracle: either complete old or complete new valid settings are recovered, never partial bytes

scenarios.name: migration-failure
scenarios.oracle: the preserved pre-migration copy remains recoverable and the failed upgrade is not activated

limits: Process exits do not prove hardware power-loss semantics.
A two-link interrupted backup retains originals and refuses retry; no automatic cleanup.
Postrename directory-sync failure is Unknown, not rollback.
Finite one-writer model and bounded pin set; no exhaustive implementation/runtime dependency proof.
